title: The Lorentzian Geometry of Tunneling in Global de Sitter at Late Time
summary: It is widely believed that Coleman--De Luccia (CDL) instantons characterize tunneling transitions in a de Sitter multiverse. Their most naive interpretation uses analytic continuation to Lorentzian de Sitter at the minimal size of the spatial three-sphere. However, what one really wants is a geometry where a small bubble of new vacuum forms within the huge spatial sphere of an old parent de Sitter.
